Europe's Gas Storage Levels Raise Supply Shortage Fears

Europe's gas storage levels have reached 71% as winter approaches, sparking concerns about potential supply shortages and increased prices. Global gasoline prices are also expected to remain elevated due to ongoing supply constraints.
